Rhymenoceros.name: Dom
Rhymenoceros.bio: DFL Commissioner, League Architect, and Chief Trade Officer. Golden rule: 'Don't smoke and trade, kids.'

PoppinChunkies.name: Tyler
PoppinChunkies.bio: The undisputed DFL powerhouse (44-12, 78% win rate). Won the historic undefeated 2023 championship.

MattyiceR.name: Matt
MattyiceR.bio: The reigning 2025 DFL Champion. Loud, proud, and frequently reminding everyone ('League champ btw') while demanding his official championship profile ribbon.

SamBaugh.name: Sam
SamBaugh.bio: Perennial contender and top-tier trade shark. Traded for Amon-Ra St. Brown and orchestrated the Mahomes & Hurts mega-swap with Tony. Always lurking in the playoff mix.

Tklumb86.name: Tony
Tklumb86.bio: Took over the franchise in 2026 from Jake (Takethecakejake), who he previously defeated in redraft. Renamed his entire QB room to '2027 picks' on the block.

LMcVicker.name: Lauren
LMcVicker.bio: Fiery competitor, connoisseur of the 'SHAME' gif, and unapologetic builder of her own dynasty empire. Sharp-witted, competitive, and forging this roster completely on her own terms.

doesntfleeze.name: Trent
doesntfleeze.bio: Self-deprecating trade cynic who always claims his team is cursed and washed, yet consistently orchestrates clever, opportunistic roster moves.

MaffuJames.name: Matt James
MaffuJames.bio: Trade enthusiast and meme maestro. Famous for entering chat debates with 'wanna be where the people are' and reminding the commish about the legendary Bitcoin payout.

JayZone13.name: Jason
JayZone13.bio: The 2024 DFL Champion. Survived regular season turbulence to orchestrate one of the most incredible Cinderella playoff runs in league history.

DukeofWales.name: David
DukeofWales.bio: Basement dweller by record, king by vibes. Famous for escaping to the Philippines during key league drafts and always making wild, unexpected blockbuster moves.
